provider: Baseten Delivery Network (BDN) model weight mirrors

free_tier.stated: No published per-account storage number. BDN 'mirrors model weights to Baseten and caches them near your replicas'; there is no documented quota and no free tier stated. Sized for 'a few GB or less' (weights that can be bundled directly with a Truss) up to multi-GB weight sources.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Not applicable — BDN is a read-only cache mounted into your own replicas ('mounted read-only'), not a public download surface. No anonymous URL.

tooling: `baseten model push` (Truss), management API POST /v1/prepare_model_upload ('Validates a model push payload and issues upload credentials'), config.yaml `weights:` / `bdn:` keys.
chaining: Not a storage product. It is a private artifact cache inside a paid inference platform; anonymous bulk read does not exist, so it cannot serve the 500 GB-1 TiB/day fetch workload at all.
limits_note: per-object-cap: not published; the system expects weights in the GB range, not the 100 GB+ range. Retention: cached by config hash, evicted by the platform ('Caching and deduplication happen behind the scenes'). No free allowance stated.
